description:
Complete version 7 research revision of Dense Algebraic Loci of Hodge Classes, with the full supplied v6 retained, explicit corrections, the matched CM Mumford–sixfold seed, algebraic auxiliary-sixfold projectors, conditional tensor transfers, a K3 deformation counterexample and exact finite checks.

F2, F3-prime, the generic mixed link and the general rational Hodge conjecture remain unproved. New geometric arguments are not Lean-formalised.
